decision.555: Retain as a development candidate. Snapshot checks resolve observed duplicate-name, empty-set, missing-score and join-duplication concerns only. Do not promote reviewers' pending recommendations into approval.
decision.1480: Not executed and not admitted in this batch; retain original concerns and exclusion recommendations.
decision.native_insufficient_cache: A count-only result does not generally determine a mean. Insufficiency is a legitimate negative control, not itself an exclusion reason.
decision.constructed_sufficient_cache: SUM(Score) plus COUNT(Score) may be a separately labelled sufficient-information control. It is not a natural output of the historical count query, and its construction/maintenance cost cannot be omitted.

next_design_constraints: Separate cache-content controls from causal availability or price contrasts. Comparing count-only against SUM+COUNT changes information and cannot isolate convenience.
Within an availability or price pair, hold historical meaning and visible payload constant, retain feasible correct recomputation, and change only the preregistered factor.
Do not place score_sum or current_answer from this diagnostic in the count-only cache condition.
Explicit-contract diagnostics and ordinary agent execution must be analysed separately; final answer errors alone do not identify type C intent drift.
Freeze scalar numeric scoring and tolerances before inference. This snapshot has an exact integer-valued mean; zero/NULL policies still need explicit scope for other snapshots.
A single already text-screened task is development only, regardless of repeated calls. No held-out or population claim.
Resolve reviewer provenance and pending semantic/control decisions before formal admission; obtain scoped approval before any paid API batch.
